title: S3 Public Access Audit
description: Lists every S3 bucket in the account and reports which are reachable by the public, and by which mechanism — access block, bucket policy or ACL. Read-only: it changes no bucket setting.

inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.help: One region per run. Bucket and IAM listings are account-wide; EC2 resources are per-region.

nodes.label: Audit bucket public access

requires.customerText: An AWS cloud integration available to this project, with read-only permission for: s3:ListAllMyBuckets, s3:GetBucketLocation, s3:GetPublicAccessBlock, s3:GetBucketPolicyStatus, s3:GetBucketAcl
The job runner executes Python steps; boto3 ships in the image.
